name: tokenbar
description: Lets Claude check your AI usage limits (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf) before starting long tasks.
long_description:
TokenBar shows how much of your AI subscription limits you have used (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf and any AI you add). This extension gives Claude three read-only tools:

- **get_usage**: current usage of every limit window (usually 5h and 7d), with the percentage used now and when each window resets.
- **time_until_reset**: seconds (and human text) until a provider's usage window resets.
- **check_budget**: whether a provider is still below a usage threshold (default 80%), so Claude can decide to start a long or expensive task now or wait for the reset.

It reads the data from the TokenBar app (local API on 127.0.0.1) when it is running, and otherwise falls back to reading the local files the AI tools keep on your computer. Nothing is sent over the network.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current usage of AI subscription limits (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf and any AI the user added to TokenBar): for each AI, the windows (usually 5h and 7d) with % used right now and when they reset.

tools.name: time_until_reset
tools.description: Seconds (and human text) until a provider's usage window resets. Default window: the first (5h).

tools.name: check_budget
tools.description: Checks if a provider is below a usage threshold (default 80%), so you can decide whether to start a long or expensive task now or postpone it until the limit resets.
